MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 17

4. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 12.5

   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

20. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

21. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 43
   C. 31
   D. 49

22. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)

   C. 9

30. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
